description: Egress Gate routing matrix (SPEC §5.3, §6, §7.1; ARCH §8.2; TASKS T-062). One row = one gate call. Shared by web/src/ai/egressGate.test.ts and the iOS EgressGate XCTest port (T-088).
conventions: nano: the fresh availability() answer for the call (no-api = no LanguageModel global). nanoEnabled: Settings "Use Gemini Nano". simulateNoNano: the Developer simulation.
policy: entries merged over the bundled routing_policy default, then sent through effectivePolicy (so the hard floor applies); omitted = the bundled default.

config: AppConfig fields overridden (grounding, data tier). capUsed: cap = at the daily cap, cap-1 = one below. consent: missing | literal (not minted by the consent sheet) | expired. uid: null = anonymous sign-in failed.
spec: the model spec kind when it is not the job default (deviceJson for S0/S1 device jobs, explain for explain, judgeJson for S4 device jobs, adversaryB for pass B).

expect.route: the GateResult route, BLOCKED with expect.reason (GateBlocked), or ERROR with expect.error (GateError code). expect.sdk: a model was built. expect.cloud: a request reached the AI host. expect.mode: the inference mode the model was built with, when it matters.
The fake SDK runs PREFER_ON_DEVICE on the device when availability is "available" and in the cloud otherwise, as firebase/ai 3.1.0 does (API-NOTES §1.4).

modes.ONLY_ON_DEVICE: ON_DEVICE_SESSION: a FirebaseAI.SystemLanguageModel.default session, never inside a HybridModel
modes.RULES: NONE: the deterministic path; no model is built

nano.available: SystemLanguageModel.default.isAvailable == true (checked fresh in the call)
nano.no-api: no on-device model API at all (FoundationModels absent, or a Simulator without Apple Intelligence): RULES-ONLY for S0/S1
nano.downloadable: treated like downloading on iOS (no user-triggered download)

iosMapping.expectations: route, reason and error are platform-neutral. expect.sdk = a model/session was created; expect.cloud = a request reached Firebase AI Logic. expect.mode uses the web names above.
